title.en: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF THE PROVINCE OF SORSOGON TO EXPEND FROM THE PROVINCIAL TREASURY THE SUM OF THREE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS, LOCAL CURRENCY, FOR RICE FOR THE SUPPORT OF VOLUNTEERS ENGAGED IN SUPPRESSING LADRONISM DURING MARCH, APRIL, AND MAY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.
title.orig: AN ACT AUTHORIZING THE PROVINCIAL BOARD OF THE PROVINCE OF SORSOGON TO EXPEND FROM THE PROVINCIAL TREASURY THE SUM OF THREE THOUSAND FIVE HUNDRED DOLLARS, LOCAL CURRENCY, FOR RICE FOR THE SUPPORT OF VOLUNTEERS ENGAGED IN SUPPRESSING LADRONISM DURING MARCH, APRIL, AND MAY, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND TWO.

title.id: Undang-Undang memberi wewenang kepada Dewan Provinsi Sorsogon untuk mengeluarkan jumlah tiga ribu lima ratus dolar mata uang lokal dari kas provinsi guna pembelian beras untuk mendukung sukarelawan yang bertugas menekan kejahatan perampokan selama Maret, April, dan Mei 1902
title.ms: Akta memberi kuasa kepada Majlis Wilayah Sorsogon untuk membelanjakan jumlah tiga ribu lima ratus dolar mata wang tempatan daripada khazanah wilayah bagi membeli beras untuk menyokong sukarelawan yang terlibat dalam menindas kegiatan lanun semasa Mac, April dan Mei 1902

text.en:
The provincial board of the Province of Sorsogon is hereby authorized to pay from provincial
fluids the sum of three thousand five hundred dollars, local currency, for rice for feeding volunteers engaged
in the suppression of ladronism in that province in March, April, and May, nineteen hundred and two.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, November 10, 1902.
